user_context.april: User recalls alternating illness and recovery, no exact dates

method_notes: Recorded activity is not a training session; warm-ups and short separate runs are included in weekly volume.
Calendar weeks begin Monday. Plan kilometres are sums of approximate session distances, not repeated week_km_est.
Only selected key activities have lap details. Adjacent ACTIVE laps merged until non-ACTIVE.
HR is weighted by lap duration; it is not an exact physiological zone measurement.
No causal attribution of performance to individual workouts; no calculated flat-course equivalent.
